plugins.name: agent-cap
plugins.description: Caps how many subagents one turn may start (default 6) so a fan-out cannot burn a rate-limit window unasked; /agent-cap <n|off|status>.

plugins.name: bg-run
plugins.description: /bg <command> runs a long job (a cargo build, a render) in the background without a Claude turn: a status line while it runs, a toast when it exits, /bg-log for the last lines.

plugins.name: correction-log
plugins.description: T13 correction-capture: when a prompt reads as a correction of the last answer, log it (date, project, your words, what was answered); /corrections dumps lines ready for STATE-trigger-observations.

plugins.name: guard-paths
plugins.description: Refuses edits to files Claude must never hand-edit: a skills manifest.json, .env files, .credentials.json; also a Bash command that writes to them.

plugins.name: limits-band
plugins.description: One line above the prompt: context fill, 5-hour and 7-day rate-limit use, session cost, and the last turn's time, tool calls and subagents; a Compact button past 70% context and a toast at 85%/95% of any limit.

plugins.name: park
plugins.description: Downhill parking: /park saves where you stopped, the next physical action and one open loop per project; the next session opens on it (Re-entry first).

plugins.name: rust-deny-guard
plugins.description: In a crate whose Cargo.toml denies unwrap_used, refuses an Edit/Write of a .rs file that would fail the crate's deny-level lints (unwrap, expect, panic!, dbg!, eprintln!, str .to_string(), as _) before a slow build finds out.

plugins.name: trigger-router
plugins.description: Playbook triggers T1-T10 as code: when a prompt matches a phrasing, Claude reads a one-line routing hint; firings are logged for /triggers.

plugins.name: written-files
plugins.description: Keeps the list of files Claude edited or wrote this session; a dim line after each turn names what changed, and /written lists them all (so the park block and the state log can be written from facts).
